newsitem.title: USA: First Banks America to buy California bank.
newsitem.headline: First Banks America to buy California bank.

text.p: First Banks America Inc said Tuesday it agreed to acquire California-based Surety Bank in a transaction providing Surety shareholders with $36.12 in cash or $38.12 in market value of First Banks stock.
Holders of Surety convertible preferred stock will receive either $30.73 in cash or $32.43 in market value of First Banks common stock.
The agreement requires that 51 percent of the Surety stock be exchanged for First Banks stock. On this basis, the total transaction price would be $7.45 million.

If more than 51 percent of Surety holders choose First banks stock in the transaction, Surety and First Banks may mutually agree to increase the stock portion of the transaction to a maximum of 65 percent of the total Surety shares.
Surety operates banking offices in Vallejo and Fairfield, Calif. and had total assets of $72.7 million.
The proposed transaction is expected to close before the end of 1997, the companies said in a joint statement.
